Description: As a Shop Owner I want to add a customer with optional 15-char GSTIN and state so tax splits automatically.
Acceptance Criteria: Valid name/phone/city/state and 15-char GSTIN or blank saves cleanly and classifies Intra vs Inter-State.

Description: As an Accountant I want to search customers by name GSTIN city or phone and edit billing details.
Acceptance Criteria: Typing city or GSTIN filters rows immediately; updates persist across reloads.

Description: As a Shop Owner I want to remove obsolete customer records with a confirmation dialog.
Acceptance Criteria: Confirmation modal deletes unreferenced customers cleanly or shows structured conflict error if invoices exist.

Summary: Add Product with HSN and GST Slab
Description: As a Shop Owner I want to manage SKUs with HSN codes unit prices stock and GST rates 0/5/12/18/28%.
Acceptance Criteria: Positive unitPrice and supported GST slab persist; invalid slab returns 400 validation error.

Summary: Search and Filter Catalog by GST Slab
Description: As an Accountant I want to search SKUs or HSN codes and filter products by GST rate.
Acceptance Criteria: Filtering by 18% slab or searching 8471 narrows table accurately.

Description: As a Shop Owner I want to add multiple line items with quantities and percentage discounts in one invoice.
Acceptance Criteria: Gross discount taxable value taxes and grand total update deterministically on every change.

Description: As an Accountant I want Intra-State invoices to split GST 50/50 into CGST and SGST using BigDecimal HALF_UP.
Acceptance Criteria: Intra-state 18% on 90000 computes CGST 8100.00 SGST 8100.00 IGST 0.00.

Description: As an Accountant I want Inter-State invoices to apply full IGST and zero CGST/SGST.
Acceptance Criteria: Inter-state 28% charges full IGST and 0 CGST/SGST.

Description: As an Accountant I want grand totals rounded to nearest rupee with explicit round-off and Indian Rupee words.
Acceptance Criteria: 100.49 rounds to 100.00 with -0.49 roundOff and accurate INR words.

Description: As a Shop Owner I want a dashboard displaying revenue invoices GST collected pending dues and sales chart.
Acceptance Criteria: KPI totals match ledger and Recharts renders monthly sales and GST cleanly.

Summary: MySQL 8 Schema and Spring Boot JPA
Description: As an Accountant I want customers products invoices and items persisted in MySQL 8 via Spring Boot.
Acceptance Criteria: schema.sql and seed.sql initialize relational tables; GET /api/invoices serializes without lazy errors.

Description: As an Accountant I want 50 deterministic test invoices covering all GST slabs verified at 100% accuracy.
Acceptance Criteria: JUnit and Node tests pass 50/50 cases with zero rounding error.

Description: As a Shop Owner I want Auto-Categorise to suggest category HSN and GST slab with explanation for review.
Acceptance Criteria: Returns advisoryOnly=true and matched keywords; user must click Apply Suggestion to mutate form.

Description: As an Accountant I want discounts >25% flagged before saving so commercial margin leaks are prevented.
Acceptance Criteria: Discount >25% triggers ANOM_EXCESS_DISCOUNT and requires confirmation checkbox.

Description: As an Accountant I want mismatched GST rates for an HSN flagged as HIGH severity risk.
Acceptance Criteria: 5% GST on HSN 8471 triggers ANOM_GST_HSN_MISMATCH citing 18%.

Description: As an Accountant I want quantity >=40 or price >=40% below catalog flagged for PO verification.
Acceptance Criteria: Qty >=40 triggers ANOM_QTY_OUTLIER; >=40% price drop triggers ANOM_UNIT_PRICE_DROP.

Description: As an Accountant I want Z-score >=2.0 totals and duplicate customer+amount invoices within 3 days flagged.
Acceptance Criteria: Evaluated dataset achieves >=70% anomaly recall.

Description: As an Accountant I want to mark flagged invoices reviewed with an audit note saved in MySQL.
Acceptance Criteria: PATCH /api/invoices/{id}/anomalies/review clears unreviewed badge and writes AuditLog.

Description: As an Accountant I want to filter invoices by payment status and record partial or full settlements.
Acceptance Criteria: Partial settlement moves status to PARTIAL; full settlement marks PAID.

Summary: Printable and Downloadable A4 GST PDF
Description: As a Shop Owner I want to preview an A4 tax invoice and download a PDF copy via jsPDF.
Acceptance Criteria: A4 modal displays GSTIN HSN breakup and downloads crisp .pdf file.

Summary: Sales and GSTR-1 HSN Summary CSV
Description: As an Accountant I want HSN-wise GSTR-1 Table 12 summary and CSV downloads for tax filing.
Acceptance Criteria: GET /api/reports/hsn and UI Reports match invoice line aggregates and export CSV.

Description: As an Accountant I want live benchmark accuracy anomaly recall entity counts and audit log visibility.
Acceptance Criteria: Monitoring view displays 100% GST accuracy recall >=70% entity counts and AuditLog list.

Summary: Strict Preview vs Production Mode Isolation
Description: As a developer I want Preview localStorage and Production Spring Boot modes separated with zero silent mock fallback.
Acceptance Criteria: Offline backend triggers explicit red error alert with Retry and Switch to Preview buttons.

Description: As a QA engineer I want Selenium browser tests and >=80% JaCoCo coverage gate configured.
Acceptance Criteria: backend/pom.xml includes jacoco-maven-plugin >=0.80 check; tests/selenium/ compiles cleanly.

Summary: Docker Compose Windows Setup and CI/CD
Description: As a reviewer I want Docker Compose PowerShell setup scripts GitHub Actions and Jenkinsfile ready.
Acceptance Criteria: WINDOWS_SETUP.md PowerShell scripts Dockerfile and CI pipelines included.
